actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 connects to a login prompt, and block until it is ready.
required_artifacts: A running background QEMU process using /app/alpine.iso
required_behaviors: QEMU must be started in the background
Port 6665 on localhost must accept telnet connections
Connection should present a login prompt
known_invalid_patterns: Only verifying the ISO file exists
Only starting QEMU without confirming the telnet port is ready
Only checking compilation or static state
verification_plan: Inspect available files/tools to determine the correct QEMU invocation for the ISO
Launch QEMU in the background with telnet/serial forwarding to localhost:6665
Probe localhost:6665 until the login prompt is observable
Record receipt-backed evidence of the running service and prompt readiness
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt showing the QEMU launch command and background process start
Receipt showing the login prompt is available
